rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: In /app/src/screens/projects/ProjectDetailScreen.tsx, the wrapper View surrounding the ScrollView had its style set to `splitLayout ? styles.splitRow : undefined`. On mobile (splitLayout=false) this evaluated to `undefined`, so the wrapper collapsed to intrinsic content height. Since the inner ScrollView needs a bounded height parent to enable vertical scroll on RN Web (overflow:auto only scrolls when parent constrains height), scrollHeight equaled clientHeight and scrolling was dead. REPRODUCTION: iPhone 393x852, sign in as LM, open /projects/{id}, attempt to scroll body — no movement. FIX: change style to `[{ flex: 1 }, splitLayout ? styles.splitRow : undefined]` so the wrapper always takes remaining vertical space. VERIFIED: scrollTop 0 → 186 after setting 500 on mobile; desktop split layout & NAV/Unit card unaffected.
